t: This is Nottingham Cottage, a small house in the grounds of Kensington Palace. It is a grace-and-favour property, so it has often been home to members of the royal family, as well as staff and employees. Prince Harry and Meghan, now the Duke and Duchess of Sussex, lived here from 2018 to 2019. The house was designed by Christopher Wren, the celebrated architect who was given responsibility for rebuilding 52 City churches after the Great Fire, including his masterpiece, St Paul's Cathedral.
